tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer TM2 Office RTPS Raichur

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Any changes in minimum labour wages during the contract period will be implemented as per KPCL orders.

The intending bidder shall have two years experience in Supply & Application of Removal type Fire Resistant Ceramic PAD Insulation for Turbines, and its connected components in any thermal power plants of capacity not less than 210MW. As a proof, bidder shall upload relevant WO/JO/PO copies.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As a proof, bidder shall upload relevant WO/JO/PO copies.

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed similar works of value not less than Rs 41.27 Lakhs during any one of the preceding five years(2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26) and shall upload the Work done certificates/ Work Completion certificates issued by competent authority (Work done of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Bidder shall upload the Work done certificates/ Work Completion certificates issued by competent authority

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder in his name should have achieved minimum average annual financial turnover of Rs, 82.54 lakhs in at least two financial years(2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26) during the last five years. As a proof of this the bidder shall upload the certified copy of the Profit and Loss account or Turnover certificate duly certified by the chartered accountant.(Turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited).

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: RTPS - Unit-6 (210MW) - PAD Insulation of Turbine and its Auxiliaries in MOH.

itemList.description: Dismantling of Old Insulation from HP& IP Turbines, HP & IP stop & Control Valve, HP & IP Bypass Valves, MS & HRH Strainers, Cross around Pipe , HP heaters, & Connected Pipe lines.

Application of New Pad Insulation to HP &, IP Turbines, HP & IP stop & Control Valve, HP & IP Bypass Valves, MS & HRH Strainers, Cross around Pipe , HP heaters, Cat-9 cement on front and rear side of TG casing & aluminium cladding of Connected Pipe lines.

Supply of New Pad Insulation to HP & IP Turbines ,HP & IP stop & Control Valve, HP & IP Bypass Valves, MS & HRH Strainers, Cross around Pipe , HP heaters, Cat-9 cement, aluminium cladding for Connected Pipe lines.
